results.title: استهداف ثكنات ومجموعات المليشيا.. الجيش اليمني يلاحق الحوثي على جبهات حجة
results.description: وثقت القوات الحكومية اليمنية من خلال مقطع فيديو جديد استهداف عناصر وتجمعات لمليشيا الحوثي في المنطقة العسكرية الخامسة.ونشر المركز الإعلامي للقوات المسلحة اليمنية، مساء أمس الخميس، مشاهد حية توثق عمليات استهداف دقيقة نفذها الطيران المسيّر ضد تجمعات وعناصر تابعين لمليشيا الحوثي الإرهابية في مسرح العمليات القتالية التابع للمنطقة العسكرية الخامسة (شمال محافظة حجة).وأظهرت المقاطع المصورة قدرات عالية في الرصد والتتبع الجوي للتحركات الحوثية المقابلة، يعقبها توجيه ضربات جوية مركزة طالت ثكنات ومجموعات للمليشيا، ما أسفر عن إيقاع خسائر بشرية ومادية مؤكدة في صفوف الحوثيين. وتأتي هذه الضربات المكثفة امتداداً للتحول الإستراتيجي الذي أعلنت عنه وزارة الدفاع اليمنية أخيراً، بإدخال الطيران المسيّر (المحلي والمستورد) بكثافة ضمن منظومات سلاح الجو والعمليات البرية، لفرض معادلة ردع حاسمة ضد الذراع الإيرانية في اليمن. وأكد مراقبون أن توالي نشر المشاهد الموثقة لضربات المسيرات في مختلف جبهات القتال، يعكس انتقال القوات المسلحة اليمنية من مرحلة الدفاع والتصدي إلى مرحلة السيطرة الجوية وتأسيس قواعد جديدة للمعركة، بما يمهد لعمليات حسم واسعة النطاق لمطاردة المليشيا واستكمال استعادة مؤسسات الدولة وإنهاء الانقلاب.

results.title: AiMOGA Robotics Shines at World Robot Conference (WRC), Showcasing Real-World Applications and Global Reach, Including Partnerships in Malaysia
results.description: KUALA LUMPUR, Malaysia and BEIJING , Aug. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- AiMOGA Robotics made a striking impact at the World Robot Conference (WRC) in Beijing, China, focusing on turning robotic technology into tangible, real-world applications that resonate with global audiences, including those in Malaysia. Instead of just talking about product specs, the brand brought robots to life through live demonstrations, answering key questions about how robots adapt to real settings and what tasks they can handle by showing, not telling. A major highlight was the real-time connection between five public service scenarios in Wuhu—such as the Wuhu Museum, First People's Hospital, and Housing Provident Fund Management Center—and the WRC venue. This showcase let attendees witness Mornine, AiMOGA's versatile service robot, delivering top-notch guidance, consultation, and reception services right before their eyes. The real-world application experience didn't stop at domestic public spaces; it reached across borders to automotive dealerships. Four domestic dealerships joined via livestream, while eight overseas outlets, including those in Malaysia, Thailand, and South Africa, shared recorded demos of Mornine handling reception duties and presenting vehicles to customers. Notably, in Malaysia's automotive scene, Mornine will support its sister brands like Chery, OMODA&JAECOO, iCAUR and Lepas more and more, elevating customer experiences at their dealerships with its efficient, intelligent services. Beyond screens, AiMOGA's intelligent traffic robot and Mornine drew professional visitors for hands-on interaction, letting them communicate directly with the robots and feel their capabilities in simulated real service scenarios. AiMOGA has already made its mark globally, with over 2,000 units delivered across more than 60 countries and regions. From Chinese public spaces to markets like Vietnam, Poland, Indonesia, and of course Malaysia, the brand's robots are adapting to diverse regional and business environments, proving their flexibility and reliability. WRC also served as a platform for AiMOGA to unveil its full product portfolio and new product strategy. The brand presented a range of robots, including the intelligent traffic robot, nurse robot, brain-controlled intelligent wheelchair, Mornine, and its latest star, Mobo. Mobo, AiMOGA's first humanoid home companion robot, made its debut at the event. Standing at around 0.9 meters tall and weighing 18 kilograms, its compact, friendly design caught everyone's attention. During the exhibition, Mobo interacted face-to-face with children, danced alongside them, and toured the venue with robot dog Argos. Unlike public service-focused robots, Mobo prioritizes daily companionship and warm human interaction, bringing robotic technology into the heart of households and adding a new dimension to AiMOGA's product matrix. AiMOGA Robotics is dedicated to building "Your Trusted Human AI Assistant" and speeding up robotic adoption by grounding technology in real-life scenarios. At WRC, a global hub for robotics innovation, AiMOGA showed how robots are moving beyond lab tests to become integral parts of urban roads, public spaces, commercial environments, and homes. This shift highlights the industry's move from proving technological possibility to making practical, reliable applications a reality. Through ongoing deployment and real-world exploration, AiMOGA is answering a critical industry question: how robots can truly integrate into daily life and become dependable, trusted assistants for people everywhere, including in dynamic markets like Malaysia.
